data.name: Vishnuvardhan
data.gender_notes: Vishnuvardhan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vishnu is the preserver in the Hindu Trimurti, the holy trinity of Hinduism, preserving the universe from evil. Vardhan means 'nourisher' or 'provider'. Vishnuvardhan is the nourisher of the universe. The name Vishnuvardhan carries the meaning “Protector of the universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Vishnuvardhan usually hope their child will grow to embody protector of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine power of preservation and protection
data.etymology: Vishnuvardhan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector of the universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vishnuvardhan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

It's a reminder that no matter what challenges come our way, there is a greater power at work keeping us nourished and protected.
